snippet.title: Hillthorn Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504050/Hillthorn/
Card-based detective game Hillthorn got a brand-new gameplay trailer during the Future Games Show at gamescom, providing a taste of its overarching mysteries. It's coming to PC & consoles in November, but you can play the demo on Steam right now.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
